snippet.title: "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" Launch Trailer - Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced Story Mode DLC
snippet.description:
The dystopian opera's final act reaches a crescendo.
Breaking down the new Azure Striker Gunvolt GX story mode, coming to PlayStation 5 and Steam as DLC for the Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced, and included with the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack! 
Official Site: https://gunvolt.com/TE/

■Additional Story Mode "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX"
"Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

Product Information
DLC Name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
Platforms: 
  Nintendo Switch 2 https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/azure-striker-gunvolt-trilogy-enhanced-nintendo-switch-2-edition-upgrade-pack-switch-2/
  PlayStation 5 https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014566
  Steam(PC) https://store.steampowered.com/app/3813350/_/
Release Date: October 22, 2026
Price: $10

*"Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" content is included in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition and Upgrade Pack.
